text:
maya: Quick sync — we're getting more customer requests to accept 'oversize' embeddings payloads (multiple vectors in one request exceeding byte limit). Proposal: server-side shard+route automatically, charge per shard, and expose a soft-warning in Console. Thoughts?

arjun: I like avoiding client changes. question: do we return 413 or accept and split? current behavior = 413.

maya: plan is to accept and internally split when `prefer_client_split` absent. If client opts-in with header we'll fast-fail with an explicit error + hint to split.

liam: telemetry ask: we need metrics for split attempts/success/fail and tag by customer + route so we can tune quotas. names: `embeds.shard_attempts`, `embeds.shard_success`, `embeds.shard_rejects`.

kevin: console UX: show a yellow badge on route usage with text "Large-requests detected — auto-sharding applied" and a link to billing implications. Also a per-tenant counter in usage UI.

tess: SLO concern: splitting increases total token work and latency. we should add a per-request latency budget and backpressure fallback to 413 when queueing would violate SLO.

arjun: agree. also need a policy for routing: small shards -> latency-priority pool, big shards -> throughput pool. smart routing should keep tail latency low.

liam: rollout plan: feature flag `auto_embed_shard_v1` default off. Start with 5% of prod traffic, monitor `embeds.shard_error_rate` and `consumer_cost_delta`.

maya: logging/contract: include `X-Embed-Shard-IDs` header in response summarizing shard ids and per-shard status. Sample:```\nX-Embed-Shard-IDs: s-123,s-124\nstatus: accepted\n```

tess: add a machine-readable reason when we fast-fail so SDKs can auto-surface split instructions: `error.code: EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH` vs `EMBED_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`.

kevin: telemetry detail: emit `embed.request.size_bytes` and `embed.request.num_vectors` for pre- and post-shard; that helps compute cost. ensure those are sampled at low-cardinality to avoid cardinality explosion.

maya: security/compliance: ensure private deployments (Dedicated/Private) get this behavior as an opt-in toggle only. Can't silently change on-prem.

deploy-bot: canary for `auto_embed_shard_v1` rolled to prod-1 (5%)

console-bot: UI flag `Enable auto-shard` created in Admin -> Routes, requires billing note (checkbox)

liam: alerts to watch: `embeds.shard_error_rate > 0.5%`, `embeds.split_latency_p50 > 2x baseline`, `billing.delta_per_hour > $1000` for initial rollouts.

sre-oncall: I'll add a runbook for `Shard failures => 413 fallback` with steps to disable flag and pin to legacy route.

arjun: one API extension: `Prefer-Split: client` header (possible values `auto|prefer-client|prefer-server`) so SDKs can opt behavior. we'll document default = `auto`.

maya: action items: 1) eng-platform: implement splitter + metrics (arjun, liam) 2) console: badge + admin toggle (kevin) 3) docs/SDK: explain header + examples (tess) 4) SRE: runbooks + alerts (sre-oncall) 5) PM: announce cost model (maya).

kevin: timeline? aiming for canary next week, 2-week observation, then ramp.

maya: cool — will post a short RFC with sample metrics, response headers, and sample console mockups.

liam: small nit — prefer `embeds.shard_{attempt,ok,err}` to keep metric names compact.

maya: noted. thanks all :rocket:
